tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and Conditions as per RFP document
Selected Concessioner/bidder shall submit Performance Bank Guarantee of Rs. 5.3 Cr

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall have a minimum of five (5) years' experience in operating sports, fitness, wellness facilities or clubs, and shall have operated at least five (5) such facilities during the preceding three (3) years

Of the facilities referred to in clause 2.1.1.a, at least three (3) facilities shall each have one (1) fitness or activity studio, one (1) swimming pool, a minimum of two (2) outdoor sports disciplines, and a minimum of two (2) indoor sports disciplines, with a minimum built-up or site area of 1,00,000 sq. ft. each
The Bidder shall submit relevant documents, such as facility details, area certificates/site plans and ownership or operation/management agreements, as proof of the above experience

The Bidder shall have at the time of Bid submission the following personnel in place or formally committed (a) Chief Operating Officer with a minimum of ten (10) years experience in sports management (b) A minimum of three (3) Senior Managers, each with a minimum of five(5) years' experience in sports management (c)The Bidder shall demonstrate a minimum of eight (8) recognized academy or brand tie-ups, spanning a minimum of four (4) distinct sport categories, Supporting documents: CV and supporting proof for each named individual.

For Qualification, it shall be mandatory to demonstrate the Threshold Financial Capability on the following criteria: a. To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-2022 to 2025-2026 (i) Achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs 05 Crores (ii)The bidder would provide the above information in form of a certificate from the statutory auditor (iii)Notarized copies of audited financial statement for the respective financial years shall be annexed in support of the above.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover
